title: Wholesale switch read at the right time
problem: Three lists read the wholesale switch when the app loaded, before the edition preview was known.
now: Return channels, import columns and quotes read it when the page shows them.
steps: Open Returns history: its tabs follow it.
notes: Where: Returns history · Import products · Quotes

steps.eval: (async () => { for (let i = 0; i < 4; i++) { const b = document.querySelector('.mn-x'); if (!b) break; b.click(); await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 300)); } })()
